asset.name: DashboardPage
asset.description: The dashboard surface with metric hierarchy, configurable sections, layout-matching skeletons, partial section failure, time-range selection, refresh, personalization, and responsive rearrangement.

requires.reason: Route boundary, metadata, scroll restoration, and focus placement are the shared page.
Title, breadcrumbs, description, and actions are the shared header.
Every generic state is delegated to the shared boundary.
Metric tiles are shared stat surfaces.

suggests.reason: Only dashboards that plot series need the chart framework.
Tabular detail suits some dashboards and clutters others.

regions.purpose: Title, time-range selection, refresh, and personalization controls.
The small set of numbers this dashboard exists to communicate.
Supporting charts, tables, or breakdowns beneath the primary metrics.
Recent events or alerts relevant to the metrics above.

rationale: Partial section failure is the defining requirement: one metric endpoint failing must degrade its own tile and leave the rest of the dashboard usable, rather than blanking the page. Twelve identical tiles in a grid is the failure mode the avoid constraint names.
